name: RGH ~Koi to Hero to Gakuen to~
original_name: RGH～恋とヒーローと学園と～
source:
Rinou Gakuen is a huge school with over 10,000 students. Iwao has been unlucky: being mistaken for a thug when he wanted to help the girls in trouble, getting in fights with the ‘school hero’, his dorm being a dump, etc. One day, he saw some students being attacked and he wanted to help, but... he can’t just help them as is since he’ll be thought as the culprit again. He decided to use ‘that’, and that was the beginning.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/03/08/march-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
璃之学园是一所拥有超过10000名学生的巨大学校。岩男一直很倒霉：想帮助陷入困境的女生时却被误认为小混混、与“校园英雄”打架、宿舍破烂不堪，诸如此类。一天，他看到几名学生遭到袭击，想上前帮忙，可是…他不能就这样直接出手，否则又会被当成罪魁祸首。于是，他决定使用“那个”，而一切也由此开始。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/03/08/march-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
